purpose.zh: 伸展脊柱，拉伸腹部前侧
purpose.en: Extend your spine and stretch the front of your belly.

text.zh: 双手轻推地，胸口慢慢抬起
text.en: Press gently through your hands and slowly lift your chest

text.zh: 髋和大腿贴地，肩膀下沉
text.en: Keep your hips and thighs down and your shoulders low.
Breathe in the stretch, then lower slowly.

commonErrors.en: Lifting the hips off the floor.

cautions.zh: 腰部不适时减小幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your lower back feels uncomfortable, and stop if it still hurts.
